lead.headline: DEEPSEEK-HARNESS SURGES TO #1 ON GITHUB
lead.deck: DeepSeek Harness is a rapidly expanding open-source project that revolutionizes software development by treating everything as a plugin, allowing for seamless integration and customization
lead.body: The project's unprecedented growth has been fueled by its innovative approach to software development, which enables developers to create complex systems by combining smaller, modular components. This philosophy has resonated with the developer community, who see the potential for increased efficiency and flexibility in their workflows. As a result, DeepSeek Harness has become a go-to solution for companies and individuals looking to streamline their development processes and stay ahead of the curve in a rapidly evolving tech landscape
